scope: offline BOT-01/02/03/04 finite plan proof for first3 tracks x2 presets; production integration not included
simulationProvenance: simulationRuns counts independent Probe.Run executions. These are not actual action-tape replay; BOT-05 runtime observer replay is separate bots-runtime evidence.
selection: Plan is fixed before race: seed modulo finite library size; repeat increments plan index modulo size. No human state/input is consulted. Seeds0..19 are predefined and none filtered.
masterVariation: Master variants are distinct legal edge positions; all have identical full accuracy and ideal effect time, with no error patterns. Finite library does not imply unlimited generated routes.
catalogTiming: Catalog IDs/hash captured before candidate search and calibration; unchanged after all plans/seeds.
